summary: Five two-way steelman attacks run against the current candidate 67c844d1, the current spec/sequencing/eval/CE bytes, and the facilitator ledger (D1-D6, S1-S8, F1-F22). All five land on one fact: no controlling document contains any S1-S8 vocabulary (0 grep hits for advisory/recommend_*, evidence_class, Query Success, core check, company laptop/PRODUCTION_BINDING_REQUIRED), and packet section 5.3 conflicts with Owner D3. Contract defects and production-binding gates are separated per attack. Phase I (sealed sha256 e4a63468...) was preserved immutably; the delta is a labelled section 5 of the final review. Overall task verdict remains BLOCKED (packet changed mid-review; current candidate superseded by later Owner decisions).
